source.check: names and divisions read on the OCR of the Larne Times nomination list of 10 May 1924; the Middle Division votes read on the Larne Times report of 14 June 1924

note: Triennial election of the seventeen electoral divisions of Larne rural district, one member each. Twelve divisions were nominated; the Middle Division alone was contested, polling on Thursday 5 June 1924. Five divisions made no nomination and were filled by co-option at the first meeting. Sole nomination; returned unopposed. Returned unopposed.
